skill.name: peer-review
skill.description: Systematic peer review toolkit for evaluating scientific manuscripts, grants, methods, statistics, reproducibility, ethics, figures, and reporting standards.
skill.summary: Review scientific work with structured checks for rigor, reproducibility, ethics, figures, and reporting compliance.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Scientific peer review requires consistent checks across methods, statistics, ethics, figures, and reporting standards. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured review workflows with actionable feedback.
actual_capabilities: Guides full manuscript reviews from initial assessment through final recommendation.
Checks methods, statistics, controls, reproducibility, ethics, and data availability.
Supports reporting guideline review for CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, ARRIVE, MIAME, and related standards.
Provides criteria for evaluating figures, tables, image integrity, and presentation slides.
Structures feedback into summary statements, major comments, minor comments, and author questions.
Includes reference material for common methodological and statistical problems.
limitations: Does not replace expert judgment from a qualified domain reviewer.
Cannot verify raw data integrity unless the user provides the data or images.
May require additional discipline-specific standards beyond the included references.
Presentation review depends on successful local PDF-to-image conversion when slides are provided as PDFs.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a journal manuscript
use_cases.description: Use a structured workflow to identify major validity concerns, minor clarity issues, and a balanced recommendation.

use_cases.title: Assess research rigor before submission
use_cases.description: Check methods, statistics, reproducibility, figures, and reporting completeness before sending a manuscript to a journal.

use_cases.title: Review a grant proposal
use_cases.description: Evaluate significance, approach, feasibility, ethics, and clarity with constructive feedback for applicants.

prompt_templates.title: Quick manuscript assessment
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a draft manuscript
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript at a high level. Summarize the research question, main findings, key strengths, and the top three concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Methods and statistics review
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate the methods and statistical analysis. Check sample size, controls, assumptions, missing data, multiple testing, and whether conclusions are supported.

prompt_templates.title: Reporting standards compliance check
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify the relevant reporting guideline for this study type and check whether the manuscript addresses the major required items.

prompt_templates.title: Full peer review report
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a complete peer review report with a summary statement, major comments, minor comments, questions for authors, and an overall recommendation.

output_examples.input: Review a manuscript describing an observational cohort study with incomplete follow-up data.
output: Summary of the study and overall recommendation
Major concern about missing data handling and possible attrition bias
Suggested sensitivity analyses and clearer reporting of participant flow

output_examples.input: Assess figures and statistical reporting in a biomedical manuscript.
output: Feedback on unclear error bars and missing sample sizes
Request for effect sizes and confidence intervals
Suggestions for replacing bar charts with plots that show distributions

output_examples.input: Review a scientific presentation PDF for readability and content flow.
output: Comments on font size, contrast, and figure readability
Recommendations for improving narrative structure and timing

best_practices: Provide the manuscript, figures, supplement, and target journal or review criteria when possible.
Ask for separate passes when you need deep statistics, ethics, or figure-integrity review.
Keep final feedback specific, constructive, and prioritized by impact on validity.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final recommendation before the methods and results have been reviewed.
Do not use the skill to replace specialist review for highly technical domain claims.
Do not request unnecessary experiments that exceed the study scope without explaining why they are essential.

faq.question: Can this skill review grants as well as manuscripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess significance, approach, feasibility, rigor, ethics, and clarity for research proposals.

faq.question: Does it support reporting guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes references for major standards such as CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, ARRIVE, MIAME, and MINSEQE.

faq.question: Can it detect image manipulation?
faq.answer: It provides checks for possible image integrity concerns, but it cannot prove manipulation without suitable image evidence and expert review.

faq.question: Will it write a full reviewer report?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize comments into a summary, major issues, minor issues, author questions, and a recommendation.

faq.question: Can it review slide decks?
faq.answer: Yes. For presentation PDFs, it instructs the assistant to convert slides to images and inspect each slide visually.

faq.question: Is this suitable for confidential peer review?
faq.answer: It can help structure confidential reviews, but users must follow journal, funder, and institutional confidentiality rules.
